items.raw_excerpt: Some people wrongly accused South West Water of intentionally discharging sewage - but it was others' fault Sewage spills out onto Cornish village ...
items.summary_en: A blocked pipe caused sewage to spill onto a village green in Cornwall. People first blamed South West Water for doing it on purpose, but the blockage was actually someone else's fault.

items.title_en: Sewage spills onto a Cornwall village green

items.raw_excerpt: Karnataka High Court mandates using "parenting time" instead of "visitation" in child custody cases to reflect a parent's integral role.
items.summary_en: A high court in India's Karnataka state told courts to use the term 'parenting time' instead of 'visitation' in all child custody cases. The court said the new wording better shows the important role a parent plays in a child's life.
items.summary_ko: 인도 카르나타카 고등법원이 모든 양육권 재판에서 '방문' 대신 '양육 시간'이라는 표현을 쓰라고 명령했습니다. 법원은 이 표현이 아이의 삶에서 부모가 맡는 중요한 역할을 더 잘 보여 준다고 설명했습니다.
items.title_en: Karnataka High Court orders 'parenting time' instead of 'visitation' in child custody cases
items.title_ko: 카르나타카 고등법원, 양육권 재판에서 '방문' 대신 '양육 시간' 사용 명령
items.title_original: Karnataka High Court orders using ‘parenting time’ instead of ‘visitation’ in all child custody cases

items.raw_excerpt: Members of the Irish Nurses and Midwives Organisation will hold lunchtime protests at hospitals across the country over delays in agreeing a new public sector pay deal.
items.summary_en: Irish nurses and midwives will hold lunchtime protests at hospitals across the country. They are unhappy about delays in agreeing a new public sector pay deal.

items.title_en: Nurses and midwives to protest at hospitals over pay

items.raw_excerpt: The simmering trademark dispute between New Zealand Rugby and Papua New Guinea's incoming NRL franchise has erupted into a legal battle after NZR filed a High Court injunction to stop the new club from using the Chiefs name.
items.summary_en: New Zealand Rugby has asked a High Court to stop Papua New Guinea's new NRL team from using the Chiefs name. The two sides are in a trademark dispute. The new club plans to join the NRL.
items.summary_ko: 뉴질랜드 럭비협회가 파푸아뉴기니의 새 NRL 구단이 치프스 이름을 쓰지 못하게 막아 달라는 신청을 법원에 냈다. 양측은 상표권 분쟁을 벌이고 있다. 새 구단은 NRL 합류를 앞두고 있다.
items.title_en: NZ Rugby seeks court order to block PNG Chiefs name
items.title_ko: 뉴질랜드 럭비, PNG 치프스 이름 막는 법원 신청

items.raw_excerpt: Capacita Defensoría La Defensoría de los Derechos Humanos del Pueblo de Oaxaca llevó a cabo en conjunto con la Organización ASILEGAL una jornada de capacitación para autoridades de seguridad munici…
items.summary_en: The Oaxaca Human Rights Commission held a training day for municipal security officers in the Central Valleys. The group ASILEGAL and a local technology institute helped lead the session. The goal was to teach officers how to better protect people's rights.
items.summary_ko: 오아하카 인권위원회가 중앙 계곡 지역의 시 경찰관들을 대상으로 교육을 열었습니다. 단체 아실레갈과 지역 기술학교가 교육을 함께 도왔습니다. 시민의 권리를 더 잘 지키는 방법을 가르치는 것이 목적이었습니다.
items.title_en: Human rights officials train local police in Oaxaca

items.raw_excerpt: A monthly report from Rentals.ca and Urbanation said the figures mark two full years of annual declines, the longest downturn the Canadian rental market has experienced in recent history.
items.summary_en: A new report says average asking rents in British Columbia fell 2.9% in September. This marks two full years of yearly drops across Canada. It is the longest rental slowdown the country has seen in recent history.
items.summary_ko: 새 보고서에 따르면 브리티시컬럼비아주의 9월 평균 임대료가 2.9% 내렸다. 캐나다 전역에서 꼬박 2년째 매년 하락세가 이어지고 있다. 최근 들어 가장 긴 임대 시장 침체다.
items.title_en: Average asking rent drops 2.9% in British Columbia

items.title_original: Average asking rent down 2.9% in B.C. in September, marking 2 years of decreases: report

items.raw_excerpt: O'Higgins y Concepción animarán llave de cuartos en la Copa Chile
items.summary_en: The Copa Chile draw has set the quarterfinal matchups. O'Higgins will face Concepcion. The Copa Chile is Chile's national football cup.
items.summary_ko: 코파 칠레 8강 대진이 정해졌다. 오히긴스와 콘셉시온이 맞붙는다. 코파 칠레는 칠레의 대표 축구 컵 대회다.

items.raw_excerpt: Una ráfaga de goles en el segundo tiempo le permitió a Deportes Antofagasta doblegar por 2-0 a Universidad de Chile en la ida e los cuartos de final por la Copa Chile. Bastián Tapia inauguró el marcador con la "ley del ex" y luego José Bandez ingresó para estirar las cifras en una serie que se resolverá el próximo 21 de octubre.
items.summary_en: Deportes Antofagasta beat Universidad de Chile 2-0 in the first leg of the Copa Chile quarterfinals. Bastian Tapia opened the score and Jose Bandez added a second goal after coming on. The tie will be decided on October 21.
items.summary_ko: 데포르테스 안토파가스타가 코파 칠레 8강 1차전에서 우니베르시다드 데 칠레를 2-0으로 이겼다. 바스티안 타피아가 선제골을 넣었고 호세 반데스가 교체로 들어와 한 골을 더했다. 이 승부는 10월 21일에 결정된다.
items.title_en: Antofagasta stuns La U with a burst of goals in Copa Chile
items.title_ko: 안토파가스타, 코파 칠레에서 라 우를 꺾다

items.raw_excerpt: The Taiwanese host signed up because she wanted to learn about AI – only to find herself tackling accounting, business and interest rates.
items.summary_en: Taiwanese TV host Matilda Tao has enrolled in an EMBA program at the National University of Singapore. She signed up hoping to learn about AI, but found herself studying accounting, business and interest rates instead. The idea came after a chance encounter on a flight from Singapore.
items.summary_ko: 타이완 방송인 마틸다 타오가 싱가포르 국립대학(NUS) EMBA 과정에 등록했다. 인공지능을 배우려고 신청했지만, 회계와 경영, 금리 같은 과목을 공부하게 됐다. 계기는 싱가포르에서 오는 비행기에서 우연히 나눈 대화였다.
items.title_en: Taiwanese host Matilda Tao joins NUS EMBA after a chance meeting on a flight
items.title_ko: 타이완 방송인 마틸다 타오, 비행기에서 우연히 만난 뒤 NUS EMBA에 입학
items.title_original: Taiwanese host Matilda Tao enrols in NUS EMBA after chance encounter on flight from Singapore

items.raw_excerpt: Bally Bagayoko, the mayor of the French town of Saint-Denis, was seen shielding students at a March in Paris.
items.summary_en: A mayor of a French town stood in front of students during a protest in Paris. He was hit by tear gas while trying to protect the young people. A video of the moment spread widely online.

items.title_en: French mayor shelters students from tear gas at Paris protest

items.raw_excerpt: Guangzhou South Railway Station handled more than 1 million passenger trips on Oct. 1, a first for any Chinese station, with trains leaving 40 seconds apart at peak times.
items.summary_en: Guangzhou South Railway Station handled over 1 million passenger trips on Oct. 1. That is a first for any Chinese station. At peak times, trains leave every 40 seconds.

items.title_en: Chinese rail hub runs a train every 40 seconds

items.raw_excerpt: The ongoing closure of Piha Beach Campground is expected to be resolved later this month, with the Waitakere Ranges Local Board set to vote on the camp's future.
items.summary_en: The Piha Beach Campground is still closed. A local board will vote later this month on what happens next. A major surf competition at Piha is now in question.

items.raw_excerpt: A museum full of taxidermied ground squirrels closes its doors after 30 years in Torrington, Alta.
items.summary_en: A small museum in Torrington, Alberta, has closed after 30 years. It was known for showing taxidermied ground squirrels in funny little scenes.

items.raw_excerpt: Uma rua do Bairro Alto, em Curitiba, terá alteração no sentido de circulação a partir das 11h desta quinta-feira (8). A mudança será implantada na Rua
items.summary_en: A street in the Bairro Alto area of Curitiba will get a new traffic direction starting at 11 a.m. this Thursday. The change may be delayed if it rains. Local drivers should check the new route.

items.title_original: Rua do Bairro Alto passará a ter novo sentido nesta quinta-feira, mas chuva pode adiar alteração; veja onde - Banda B

items.raw_excerpt: The Commerce Commission is warning retailers that product safety is non-negotiable as it takes bargain retailer PD Mart to court over allegedly non-compliant goods.
items.summary_en: A discount store in New Zealand is being taken to court. The Commerce Commission says the shop may have sold goods that were not safe. It warns that product safety rules must always be followed.

items.raw_excerpt: Từ tờ mờ sáng, chợ cá Tam Tiến (TP. Đà Nẵng) đã rộn ràng cảnh tàu thuyền cập bờ, người mua kẻ bán tất bật với những mẻ hải sản vừa đánh bắt sau một đêm trên biển. Phiên chợ ven biển còn là điểm đến để du khách khám phá nhịp sống mộc mạc, nguyên bản của làng chài.
items.summary_en: At first light, the Tam Tien fish market in Da Nang comes alive as boats return to shore. Buyers and sellers crowd around the fresh catch brought in after a night at sea. The seaside market is also a place where visitors can see the simple, original life of a fishing village.

items.summary_en: A gourmet fair using local Kanazawa ingredients starts on November 19. The event is called Kanazawa Story Dinner. It takes place at Hyatt Centric Kanazawa.

items.raw_excerpt: Just as he does every year, Craig Lowndes is drawing on memories of Australian motorsport legend Peter Brock to fuel yet another attempt at the Bathurst 1000.
items.summary_en: Craig Lowndes keeps using memories of Peter Brock to push for another Bathurst 1000 win. The Australian racing legend still inspires drivers two decades after his death. Bathurst fans say his spirit lives on forever.
items.summary_ko: 크레이그 로운즈는 피터 브록의 기억을 떠올리며 다시 한 번 바서스트 1000 우승에 도전한다. 사망 20년이 지난 지금도 이 호주 레이싱 전설은 선수들에게 영감을 준다. 바서스트 팬들은 그의 정신이 영원히 살아 있다고 말한다.
items.title_en: Brock's memory drives Bathurst racers 20 years on

items.raw_excerpt: Some hotel rooms are going for more than seven times their usual rates, amid a packed calendar of over 40 business conferences and gatherings around the Formula 1 period.
items.summary_en: Hotel prices in Singapore jumped as the city hosted over 40 business events around the Formula 1 season. Some rooms cost more than seven times the normal rate.

items.raw_excerpt: A mathematics professor and provost at Dartmouth College has been accused of using AI to write nearly all of his academic papers and opinion pieces, sparking criticism from colleagues and students who are calling for his dismissal.
items.summary_en: A senior official at Dartmouth College is accused of using AI to write almost all of his academic papers and opinion pieces. Colleagues and students are unhappy and want him removed from his job. The school has not said what it will do.

items.title_en: Dartmouth provost accused of using AI to write nearly all his papers
